parameters.aggregation_order: First equal-weight the three regions at each shared origin; then average the 181 days.
parameters.estimand: mean QS delta = R20 minus R19; negative favors R20
parameters.relative_improvement_percent: -100 * mean paired QS delta / mean R19 QS
parameters.sample_construction: Uniform block starts on the 181-day grid; wrap modulo 181; concatenate blocks and truncate to 181 days.
parameters.paired_resampling: Identical day indices for R19 and R20; no separate region or arm resampling.
parameters.relative_denominator: Recompute the R19 mean within each bootstrap replicate; reject zero denominators rather than dropping replicates.
